title: Pure Ryzeal
summary: Ryzeal cards with a full Rank 4 Xyz toolbox and generic staples. Because Ice, Sword, and Ext Ryzeal and Ryzeal Detonator are capped by the banlist, the 2025 support—Star Ryzeal and Ryzeal Mass Driver—carries extra weight, and almost every Ryzeal self-summon locks the Extra Deck to Rank 4 Xyz Monsters.

summary.title: Starters
points: Ice Ryzeal (Semi-Limited) Special Summons a Ryzeal monster from the Deck when Normal Summoned.
Ext Ryzeal (Limited) sends an Xyz Monster from the Extra Deck to the GY (such as Mereologic Aggregator or Eclipse Twins) to Special Summon itself, then searches a Level 4 FIRE Thunder (Sword Ryzeal).
Sword Ryzeal (Semi-Limited) Special Summons itself while you control a Ryzeal monster on the field or in the GY and searches a Level 4 LIGHT Pyro (Ice, Ext, or Star Ryzeal) on summon.
Star Ryzeal detaches 1 material from an Xyz Monster you control to Special Summon itself from the hand and Sets a Ryzeal Spell/Trap directly from the Deck.

summary.title: Opening: Ice Ryzeal or Ext Ryzeal
steps: Normal Summon Ice Ryzeal to Special Summon Sword Ryzeal from the Deck, and use Sword Ryzeal to search Star Ryzeal or Ext Ryzeal.
Overlay Ice Ryzeal and Sword Ryzeal into Ryzeal Duo Drive, then detach 1 material to Special Summon Star Ryzeal from the hand and Set Ryzeal Cross or Ryzeal Plugin from the Deck.

Activate Ryzeal Duo Drive to detach 2 materials and search two Ryzeal cards (such as Node Ryzeal and Ryzeal Mass Driver), Special Summon Node Ryzeal to revive a Ryzeal from the GY, and overlay into Ryzeal Detonator.

summary.title: Xyz Material & Recursion Engine
summary.text: Ryzeal monsters treat Xyz Monsters on the field and in the GY as fuel: Ext Ryzeal dumps Mereologic Aggregator (to negate a face-up card) or Eclipse Twins from the Extra Deck, Node Ryzeal sends a card from your hand or field to the GY to revive a Ryzeal in Defense Position, and Ryzeal Cross detaches 1 material from a Ryzeal Xyz once per turn to negate an opponent's monster effect as it resolves while recycling two Ryzeal cards to draw 1.

summary.title: Control & Rank 4 Toolbox
points: Ryzeal Detonator (Limited) attaches a monster from the GY on summon and detaches 1 material whenever the opponent activates a card or effect to destroy 1 card on the field—without once-per-chain restrictions.
Eclipse Twins attaches itself or revives up to two Rank 4 or lower Xyz Monsters from your GY when sent to the GY, letting a destroyed Ryzeal Detonator return with fresh material.
Number 60: Dugares the Timeless, Number 106: Giant Hand, Number 80: Rhapsody in Berserk, Number 103: Ragnazero, and Castel round out the Rank 4 toolbox.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Ryzeal Plugin Special Summons a Ryzeal or Xyz Monster from your GY or banishment and attaches a Ryzeal card from the Deck to a Rank 4 Xyz.
Ryzeal Mass Driver boosts your Ryzeals by 1000 ATK, attaches itself from the GY to a Rank 4 Xyz, and banishes a card from the opponent's GY when sent from the hand to the GY.
Ryzeal Plasma Hole destroys face-up cards the opponent controls up to the number of Ryzeal Xyz Monsters you control, and banishes itself from the GY to perform a Rank 4 Xyz Summon.

summary.title: Left out
summary.text: The page's Mulcharmy cards, Maxx "C", Pot of Desires, and Seventh Tachyon consistency packages are omitted in this pure Ryzeal build.

main: Ice Ryzeal
Semi-Limited. Normal Summoned: summons another Ryzeal from the Deck.
Sword Ryzeal
Semi-Limited. Summons itself next to a Ryzeal; summoned, searches a LIGHT Pyro.
Ext Ryzeal
Limited. Sends an Xyz from the Extra Deck to summon itself; summoned, searches a FIRE Thunder.
Star Ryzeal
Newest support. Detaches a material to summon itself, then Sets a Ryzeal Spell/Trap from the Deck.
Node Ryzeal
Summons itself with an Xyz in your field or GY; revives a Ryzeal.
Palm Ryzeal
Shuffles a Ryzeal back to summon itself; a Level 4 body for the Rank 4s.
Ryzeal Cross
Field Spell: negates an opposing monster effect with a Ryzeal Xyz material, and recycles two Ryzeals for a draw.
Ryzeal Plugin
Quick-Play: revives an Xyz or Ryzeal and attaches a Ryzeal from the Deck.
Ryzeal Mass Driver
Newest support. +1000 ATK to your Ryzeals and attaches itself to a Rank 4; from the hand to the GY, banishes a card from their GY.
Ryzeal Plasma Hole
Destroys a face-up card per Ryzeal Xyz; from the GY, Xyz Summons on the spot.
